description:
Client Job Description 
 However, ALL candidates chosen for an interview will have to attend a personal interview, NO Skype, NO exceptions 

 The Client seeks to augment its current Business Objects capabilities by engaging a contract (temporary, 6 months) resource who can bring immediate value in assisting with a review of current BOE environment and configuration, as well as planning and executing an upgrade from BOE 4.0 to 4.2 environment. 

 During this engagement this person will also be expected to train/mentor current IT staff in the best day-to-day practices to administer the overall BOE system. 

 This e-requisition is seeking a contractor experienced in a Business Object environment to assist personnel in upgrading Crystal Reports operating system. 

 The engagement will last no more than six months, and the selected contractor will be responsible for ensuring that there are no problems during the upgrade in Business Objects from version 4.0 to version 4.2. 

 This contractor must have at least 7 years of experience in all Business Objects Environment and Crystal Reports development. 

 

 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ Months Contract  
 
 INTERVIEW: Phone - local candidates strongly preferred 
 
 Location:  Richmond, VA 
 
 Manager may elect to conduct an initial phone interview.
